name: Dooku's first lightsaber
description: This lightsaber was built by Dooku, future leader of the Confederacy of Independent Systems and Sith Lord, during his time as a Jedi Padawan. At some point after becoming a Jedi Knight, Dooku set aside his first weapon and built a new and superior lightsaber with a personalized design that he used throughout his years as both a Jedi Master and Sith.
